props.text: Apple patches a zero-click image bug, Claude beats human hit-rates on protein design, Pennsylvania makes AI data centers pay their own grid costs, and capital keeps moving into H200 chips and Bitcoin treasuries.

props.title: Apple patches a zero-click ImageIO code-execution bug

props.text: iOS 26.6.1, iPadOS 26.6.1, and macOS Tahoe 26.6.2 fix CVE-2026-65346, an ImageIO integer-overflow where just rendering a malicious image can trigger code execution — found by Meta's Red Team X. No known in-the-wild exploitation yet, but zero-click image bugs are prime spyware material — update today.

props.title: Claude autonomously designed 354 working protein binders

props.text: Anthropic had Claude Opus 4.8 run existing protein-design and co-folding models end-to-end across 15 drug targets (PD-L1, EGFR, TNFα, others), generating 1,320 candidates. Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience lab-tested them: 354 bound (22.6–35.1% hit rate vs. the field's usual 10–15%). Lab-verified, not a benchmark claim — a real jump in de novo drug-discovery throughput.

props.title: Pennsylvania signs the country's strictest AI data-center rules

props.text: Shapiro's order pulls AI data centers from Fast Track permitting, bans data-center NDAs, requires local approval before construction, and makes developers over 25MW cover their own grid-upgrade costs plus clean power. 100+ PA data-center proposals were in talks — this resets their economics and could become a template other states copy.

props.title: Nvidia's H200 chips are flowing into China again

props.text: ByteDance and Tencent have each reportedly received ~10,000 H200 units in recent weeks under the revised US license-review policy — sales stay capped at 50% of volume sold to US customers, plus certification. Reopens a multi-billion-dollar China channel for Nvidia, though still short of pre-restriction access.

props.title: Metaplanet commits 2,100 BTC to launch a US Bitcoin treasury platform

props.text: Metaplanet will contribute 2,100 BTC (~$132M) plus $2.5M cash into Nasdaq-listed Super League Enterprise, taking a 95.7% stake and renaming it Superplanet (ticker SUPA); closing expected Q4 2026. Metaplanet already holds ~43,000 BTC. A second US Bitcoin-treasury vehicle for Metaplanet — watch SUPA/SLE around the Q4 close.
